responsibility: Declares the trimmed_graph helper used to project an exploded_graph onto the backward-reachable subgraph for a selected destination node. It defines the lightweight wrapper node, edge, traits, and cluster types, membership queries for retained exploded edges, and the dump-argument plumbing needed to render the trimmed graph using the inner exploded-graph formatting.
same_name_distinction: Declares the trimmed_graph wrapper types, traits, and membership/query interface for projecting an exploded_graph onto nodes and edges that reach a destination, while trimmed-graph.cc performs the backward-reachability trimming and creates the wrapper nodes and edges.
